ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json fun licenseType(item) = if ( (item.EmployeeIndicator == "Y") and (((item.Location.CountryCode == "USA") and (item.EmploymentDetail.EmployeeTypeCode == "R")) or ((["GBR","DEU"] contains item.Location.CountryCode) and (["R", "T", "L", "I"] contains item.EmploymentDetail.EmployeeTypeCode))) ) "Community" else if ( !(vars.salesforceBFSystemAdministrator contains item.EmpId) and !(vars.salesforceBFStandardUserAdministrator contains item.EmpId) ) "Chatter" else null --- vars.validWorkers map((item, index)-> { (item.EmpId) : licenseType(item) })

%dw 2.0 output application/json var downgradeEmpIds = (payload filter($.Alias startsWith("X"))).Alias map($[1 to -1]) var systemAdminProfileId = (vars.profileIds filter($.Name == p('sfProfileName.bairdSystemAdministrator'))).Id[0] var standardUserProfileId = (vars.profileIds filter($.Name == p('sfProfileName.bairdFoundationStandardUser'))).Id[0] var associateProfileId = (vars.profileIds filter($.Name == p('sfProfileName.bairdAssociate'))).Id[0] var chatterProfileId = (vars.profileIds filter($.Name == p('sfProfileName.chatterFreeUser'))).Id[0] fun getPhone(data) = do{ var AreaCode = data.AreaCode var ContactNumber = data.ContactNumber --- if(data != null and AreaCode != null and ContactNumber != null) (AreaCode ++ "-" ++ ContactNumber) else if(data !=null and AreaCode != null and ContactNumber == null) AreaCode else if(data !=null and AreaCode == null and ContactNumber != null) ContactNumber else "#N/A" } --- (vars.validWorkers filter(downgradeEmpIds contains $.EmpId)) map(item, index) -> { //APPEND.INVALID_TO_EMAIL_IN_ALL_ENVIRONMENTS_FOR CHATTER_LICENSE "Email": if ( p('api.env') == "PROD" ) (lower(((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0]) ++ ".invalid")) else (lower(((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0]) ++ ".invalid")), "FederationIdentifier": item.EmpId, "EmployeeNumber": item.EmpId, "FirstName": item.FirstName, "LastName": item.LastName, "Alias": item.EmpId, "Username": if ( p('api.env') == "PROD" ) (lower(((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0]) default "") ++ "-bairdfoundation") else (lower(((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0]) default "") ++ "-bairdfoundation." ++ lower(p('userName.sandboxName'))), "ProfileId": if ( vars.salesforceBFSystemAdministrator contains item.EmpId ) systemAdminProfileId else if ( vars.salesforceBFStandardUserAdministrator contains item.EmpId ) standardUserProfileId else if ( vars.licenseType[item.EmpId][0] == "Community" ) associateProfileId else if ( vars.licenseType[item.EmpId][0] == "Chatter" ) chatterProfileId else null, "CommunityNickname": item.UserName, "IsActive": item.EmploymentDetail.Active, "EmailEncodingKey": "ISO-8859-1", "TimeZoneSidKey": "America/Chicago", "LocaleSidKey": "en_US", "LanguageLocaleKey": "en_US", "Phone": getPhone((item.Phones filter($.TelecommunicationsNumberTypeCode == "WORK" and $.Type == "Landline"))[0]), "Title": item.ProfessionalTitleName default "#N/A", "CompanyName": "Baird", "Department": item.Department.Name default "#N/A", "Division": if ( item.BusinessUnitOrganization == null or !(vars.businessUnitIds.Baird_BU_ID__c contains item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Descriptor.Id) ) "#N/A" else if ( item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Level <= 2 ) item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Descriptor.Name else if (vars.businessUnitIds.Baird_BU_ID__c contains item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Level2Descriptor.Id)item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Level2Descriptor.Name else "#N/A", "Street": trim(item.Location.Address1 default "" ++ " " ++ (item.Location.Address2 default "") ++ " " ++ (item.Location.Address3 default "") ++ " " ++ (item.Location.Address4 default "")), "City": item.Location.CityName default "#N/A", "State": item.Location.StateAbbreviation default "#N/A", "PostalCode": item.Location.PostalCode default "#N/A", "Country": item.Location.CountryCode default "#N/A", "GL_Code__c": item.Department.GlCode default "#N/A", "Integration_BU_Name__c": item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Descriptor.Name default "#N/A", "Integration_Department_Name__c": item.Department.Name default "#N/A", "Integration_Level_2_Name__c": item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Level2Descriptor.Name default "#N/A", "Integration_Level_3_Name__c": item.BusinessUnitOrganization.Level3Descriptor.Name default "#N/A", "UserRoleId": null, "Id": null }
